task: Responsive phone and tablet adaptation of CodeMie UI following the Figma mobile section: mobile top bar and navigation overlay, page sidebars as overlays, tables as cards, small-screen dialogs, chat without resizable side panels, adapted forms, analytics, katas and login. Desktop (>= 1024px) must stay unchanged.

key_reasoning.reason: Touches the app shell, navigation, page sidebars, tables, dialogs, page header, cards and the chat page, plus page-level adjustments in assistants, skills, data sources, workflows, analytics, katas, settings and login. Needs new abstractions (mobile shell state, top bar, card list) and a second layout for shared components rendered on nearly every page.

Figma defines the mobile shell (top bar, navigation overlay, sidebar and right-panel overlays, card rows) and some screens; pages without designs (workflow editor, analytics widgets, katas, login) need assumptions, and the breakpoint that separates the two layouts is not specified.

No responsive precedent in the codebase. Desktop must stay identical for about 50k users while shared components gain a mobile branch; window resizes and tablet rotations cross the breakpoint at runtime; Mobile Safari needs viewport, dvh and input-zoom handling; the global matchMedia test stub means existing tests only exercise desktop. UI-only, so rollback is a plain revert.
Expected 40+ modified files across components, pages, hooks, store and global styles, plus 4-6 new files (media-query hook, layout constants, top bar, card list).

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from L (4) to XL (5): shared foundations (Table, Sidebar, PageLayout, Popup, Card, Navigation) are rendered by nearly every page.
